decision_reason: Prefer the scored and Reweight-weighted signal MC peak shape and reduce instability from sparse DATA determining the signal shape.

data.signal_shape: MC sigma1, sigma2 and fraction fixed; common mean floats

fit_contract.significance: one-sided local profile-likelihood sqrt(max(0,q0)); null signal yield fixed to zero, signal mean and width scale fixed at alternative best fit, background reprofiled

known_limitations: The width scale is at a boundary for all seven v19 working points: xeff10 at 0.9 and xeff15-xeff40 at 1.5.
The xeff40 single-start result is an inferior local minimum relative to the earlier 1.15-range solution and is not valid for physical ranking.
Nominal model status does not select a final working point and does not calibrate local or global significance.
A multi-start or width-scale profile scan requires separate user confirmation before changing the minimization strategy.
